Current focus

What I'm working on now

A living snapshot of my current learning and project work.

Studying and direction

I'm comparing English, business management, and international management before deciding what to study. I haven't chosen a degree or career path yet, so this is exploration rather than a settled plan.

Building

I'm continuing to investigate how the Ultimate Reality Researcher handles sources, competing arguments, confidence, and model fallbacks. The public GitHub repository is the place to inspect the code and current implementation.

Desk research

I used public trade data and Singapore's official import guidance to study a specific question: what would need to be checked before anyone could responsibly recommend Tunisian olive oil for Singapore? The study is not a launched business, buyer research, or a validated market-entry recommendation.

What I want to improve

I'm trying to make my writing clearer, keep facts separate from estimates, and show the limits of a project alongside its useful findings. This page is a current snapshot, not a promise that every priority will stay the same.
